items.title: Jefferies adds Uber to ’Franchise Picks’ as bullish setup strengthens
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies elevated Uber to a "Franchise Pick" and raised its price target on the stock to $110 from $100 per share in a note Monday, saying the setup for the ride-hailing and delivery company looks increasingly bullish following strong earnings and investor meetings.
